result.markdown: --- title: >- [embedding.EmbeddingOllama]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Creates an embedding function provider backed by a local Ollama server. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_embedding_ollama.py#L6-L78){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python embedding.EmbeddingOllama( model="embeddinggemma-2:latest", base_url="http://localhost:11434/v1", api_key=None, batch_size=20 ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Implements the [EmbeddingProvider](`raghilda.EmbeddingProvider`) interface. This provider uses Ollama's OpenAI-compatible API with defaults for a local server. Stores created with it can be reconnected without setting `OPENAI_API_KEY`. Pull an embedding model before using it (e.g., `ollama pull embeddinggemma-2`). Browse available embedding models at [ollama.com/search](https://ollama.com/search?c=embedding). ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [model]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["embeddinggemma-2:latest"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The Ollama embedding model to use. Default is "embeddinggemma-2:latest". [base_url]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["http://localhost:11434/v1"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The base URL for the Ollama server's OpenAI-compatible API. Default is "http://localhost:11434/v1". Change this when Ollama runs on another machine or port. [api_key]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The API key sent with each request. Ollama does not check it, so this is only needed when the server sits behind a proxy that requires one. If None, a placeholder value is used. [batch_size]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[20]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The number of texts to process in each batch when calling the API. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#5bcfeaa6 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from raghilda.embedding import EmbeddingOllama provider = EmbeddingOllama(model="embeddinggemma-2:latest") embeddings = provider.embed(["hello world", "testing embeddings"]) print(len(embeddings)) print(len(embeddings[0])) # Dimension of the embedding ``` :::
